LanguageData.Gun_MAC-11_RWP.label: MAC-11
LanguageData.Gun_MAC-11_RWP.description: The MAC-11 is a compact, fully automatic submachine gun known for its high rate of fire. Ideal for short-range combat, it can deliver a barrage of bullets in quick succession but requires frequent reloading. Its lightweight design makes it easy to carry, but its accuracy diminishes rapidly with distance.
